sources.games: 1129 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 48.4%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py luna.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Bloodthorn, Butterfly, Black King Bar.

rules.name: Silver Edge

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає її на 5 секунд

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Shadow Walk, the attack that ends the invisibility disables the target's passive abilities for 5 s, +300 physical damage and caps its movement speed at 200. High-rank Lunas buy it against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: 39% of 84 games against them (7% otherwise), won 61% against 41%.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: magic_wand 76% (-1), wraith_band 22% (2), power_treads 100% (6), mask_of_madness 94% (10), yasha 99% (13), manta 98% (17), dragon_lance 59% (19), force_staff 32% (25), black_king_bar 56% (26), hurricane_pike 32% (26), butterfly 71% (26), lesser_crit 26% (29), aghanims_shard 39% (31), greater_crit 21% (32), satanic 40% (34).

skills.basis: 1129 games: maxed luna_moon_glaive > luna_lucent_beam > luna_lunar_orbit 602 (win 50.3%), luna_lucent_beam > luna_moon_glaive > luna_lunar_orbit 318 (win 47.2%), luna_moon_glaive > luna_lunar_orbit > luna_lucent_beam 184 (win 47.8%); talents 10: Moon Glaives Damage Reduction 997/1125 (48.4%), Lucent Beam Ministun 128/1125 (48.4%); 15: Lunar Orbit Glaive 682/1106 (51.3%), Lucent Beam Damage 424/1106 (45.8%); 20: Lunar Orbit Damage / Speed 577/832 (58.8%), Eclipse Cooldown 255/832 (52.5%); 25: / Lunar Blessing Allied/Self Damage 312/325 (65.1%), Lucent Beam Hits An Additional Target 13/325 (38.5%).

suppress.illusions: Moon Glaives already bounce each attack to up to 6 enemies within 500 (Valve 7.41f) and Lunar Orbit hits all around her; high-rank Lunas do not add Maelstrom against illusion heroes.
